name: Boar, Babirusa
source: Speak with Animals: Animal Companions II
book: Speak with Animals: Animal Companions II

facets.bk: Speak with Animals: Animal Companions II

body:
Babirusa CR 2

This boar has long antler-like protrusions above its snout. It scrapes the ground in a threat.

XP 600
N Medium animal
Init +0; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 10, flat-footed 16 (+6 natural)
hp 18 (2d8+9)
Fort +6, Ref +3, Will +1

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee gore +4 (1d10+4)

STATISTICS

Str 17, Dex 10, Con 17, Int 2, Wis 13, Cha 4
Base Attack +1; CMB +4; CMD 14 (18 vs. trip)
Feats Toughness
Skills Perception +6

ECOLOGY

Environment tropical rain forests, near rivers
Organization solitary or group (4 – 10)
Treasure none

The babirusa boar is also known as a deer-pig for its antler-like tusks that protrude from the top of its head.

They are in other respects like typical boars but they have more deadly tusks at the cost of being less ferocious than their cousins.
